reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that textual n-gram overlap fails for tabular sports data because two distinct games may legitimately share identical stat lines. The solution is to shift from content-based to temporal identity keys. This enables a precise contamination gate defined by intersection of (game_id, feature_window) pairs across datasets. The universal lens unifies this as a temporal shingle operation. GSI models contamination as a probabilistic event using Bayesian inference over temporal overlaps. GSE encodes this as a state transition function that consumes training and validation frames and outputs a cleaned frame with metadata. The failure mode arises when temporal keys are misaligned or missing, leading to false negatives. The dual nature of the system lies in its ability to both detect and act—emit cleaned data rather than merely warn.
